subject.title: refactor: remove expired plugin compatibility surfaces

question: Does the explicit early-removal approval apply to the release that will contain this PR, despite registry `removeAfter` dates through July 30, 2026?
rationale: The patch intentionally removes external plugin compatibility surfaces ahead of their published dates; source and tests can validate mechanics, but only the release owner can authorize the release-timing exception.

options.title: Confirm the early-removal exception
options.body: Approve this sweep for the intended release with the six listed live contracts still deferred.

options.title: Defer July 24–30 records
options.body: Keep only already-expired removals and move the remaining dated records to a post-window release.

options.title: Delay the release containing this PR
options.body: Merge the sweep only if its release date is after all affected removal windows.

recommendation.title: Confirm the early-removal exception
recommendation.body: Approve this sweep for the intended release with the six listed live contracts still deferred.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied PR context attributes the approved sweep and release-facing compatibility plan to this contributor’s current compatibility work.
